concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 Acceptance Scenario 1 mandate tracing on a subset of 100 ImageNet validation images. Task T011 references '[TRACE_SIZE]' and a 'default 100' but does not explicitly implement the fixed 100-image requirement, instead deferring to a research decision. This leaves the FR-001 requirement unimplemented in the task list.

FR-001 and US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1 require benchmarking on the same subset size (100 images) or a clearly defined disjoint set derived from the 100-image trace set. Task T019 implements a benchmark on 40 images (indices 100-139) based on plan feasibility notes, but lacks a task explicitly covering the FR-001 requirement for the full 100-image trace set or a task justifying the reduction to 40 as a spec-compliant alternative.

FR-007 requires the system to perform a sensitivity analysis by sweeping the clustering distance threshold over a concrete set (e.g., {0.01, 0.05, 0.1}). Task T027 mentions this set but states 'The exact set of thresholds is defined in the research phase,' effectively deferring the implementation of the specific sweep required by FR-007. A task must explicitly implement the sweep with the concrete set defined in the spec.

FR-001 and FR-002 define the trace size (100) and timestep schedule (100) as fixed constants for reproducibility. Task T008 configures these as mutable environment variables (`TRACE_SIZE`, `BENCHMARK_SIZE`) without a task to enforce the spec-mandated fixed values or validate them against the spec requirements, risking a violation of the reproducibility principle.

Task T032b proposes 'batch size auto-tuning logic,' which contradicts the plan's explicit rejection of batch processing in favor of mandatory 'One-by-One Processing' (Complexity Tracking). While this is a plan contradiction, the task itself exists but implements a feature that the plan explicitly forbids, creating a stale/contradictory task entry.
